entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain. Amounts may approach warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Note, rain spreading north this afternoon, then easing about Stewart Island this afternoon and over the mainland from evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.summary: Expect 110 to 150 mm of rain about the main divide, and 70 to 110 mm within 25 km farther east. Peak rates of 25 to 35 mm/h expected about the divide. Freezing level about 3000 metres. entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale northwest winds gusting 120 km/h in exposed places, but damaging gusts of 140 km/h possible in exposed parts of the High Country. Note, winds easing from the south from tonight. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low. Changes: Gust speed about the High Country increased.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 200 to 250 mm of rain about the ranges, but 300 mm is possible about isolated peaks. This is in addition to the rain that has already fallen. Coastal areas may only get 30 to 60 mm of rain during this period, but brief high intensity rainfall there could still cause impacts. Peak rates of 25 to 35 mm/h expected from evening, mainly about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.
